title: Build the UK
description: Building the United Kingdom and overseas territory at a 1:1 scale.
body:
The following information is available at https://btuk.org
# Build the UK

Build the UK invites Minecraft players to join and contribute to the construction of every building and landmark in the UK, effectively creating a virtual copy of the country. It’s a community-driven initiative where builders construct their favourite area in the UK. This includes famous landmarks like Big Ben, the Tower of London, Buckingham Palace, Stonehenge, and many others.

## Start Building

Are you a Minecraft builder with a passion for architecture? Join Build the UK to craft your own city or recreate iconic British landmarks!
